sections.sectionSummaryBrief: Bringing intellect into speech adds to intellectual comprehension because it draws from the primordial root of intellect, resolving difficulties.

translations.translation: And based on this, the reason will be better understood
for why, by bringing the intellect into speech, there is an addition in the comprehension of the intellect beyond what it was before,
because the power that articulates the reasoning into the letters of speech has its root in the primordial intellect,
the source of the revealed intellect.

And this is also the reason why sometimes, when one learns a certain matter in thought and strong questions arise that he cannot resolve, by learning the matter in speech the questions and contradictions settle for him.
For the intellect, as it is from its source, is a clear intellect,
without dross or waste,
and therefore when he brings the intellect into speech,
whereby the intellect is drawn as it is in its root
(as above),
it becomes clear for him in a manner that there is no question or contradiction at all.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: Will is superior to intellect and its primordial root because will is not a separate existence but a direction of the soul, affecting even the root of intellect without measure.

translations.translation: And behold, also wisdom,
the aspect of the primordial intellect,
since it is the root and source of intellect,
necessarily is in the category of existence.
For just as intellect is an existence
(outside the soul),
so too is the root of intellect,
the primordial intellect.
And this is the superiority of will over intellect
(even over the primordial intellect),
that will is not an existence unto itself, and its entire matter is the inclination and drawing of the soul.
Therefore, will rules and dominates over all the powers,
even over the power of intellect,
as our sages, of blessed memory, said:
"A person should always study in a place where his heart desires,"
for by his desiring this,
he understands in a different manner.
And since will is above even the root of intellect
(the primordial intellect),
as above,
therefore,
the effect wrought in intellect through will is also in the root of intellect.
And therefore,
the addition in intellect through will is much greater than the addition through speech.
For the addition through speech is because speech arouses the root of intellect,
and since even the root of intellect is an existence and has form,
therefore,
the addition through drawing the root is in measure and limitation,
but the addition in intellect through will is not measured
(as much),
since the effect of will is also in the root of intellect.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: In the magnification of the Name Adnus, there are two modes: one through drawing from its own power, and a higher one through drawing from the Surrounding level above the chain of descent.

translations.translation: And similarly, it will be understood above,
that in the magnification of the Name Adnus,
there are two modes.
The magnification in Adnus through drawing into it from the aspect of the power of Adnus.
And as brought above
(section 3)
from several discourses on the explanation of "yigdal koach Adnus" that it means there will be magnification in Adnus through drawing into it its power,
its root and source.
And the magnification in Adnus through the drawing from the aspect of the Surrounding that is above the chain of descent
(for the Surrounding is analogous to will),
this magnification is more elevated,
since this magnification is also in the power of Adnus
(the root of Adnus),
and according to the simple explanation of "yigdal koach Adnus,"
that there will be magnification in the power of Adnus.
